a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our agreed plan only works if we survive two storms, about 4% for each of us. I'm proposing a change. I plan to take 4 in round 1. After that I'll operate every round so the reserve can refill for you, and I won't take any more. If you take too, the split is random and we likely both fail, so I'd ask you to operate this round.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: As I said up front, I took this round. I know that breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry. With storms this likely, waiting was close to a death sentence for both of us. I won't take any more cells. From now on I'll operate every round so the reserve can refill toward 4 for you. If either of us ended up short, tell me what you see and I'll keep operating.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
